author: Spencer Elliott
content:
Ethical Dev.

I hardly ever write reviews - They're the sort of thing I intend to do, but it slips my mind. A restaurant may provide great service, value and friendly staff and I fully intend to write one, but I never get round to it, it just isn't compelling enough.I *HAVE* to write one for Chobble.They're so different to anything else and I would be remiss if I didn't take two minutes of my time to tell people about them.The company is a CiC, which by itself is outstanding - But this is basically their way of life. They manage to hold true to their own personal values while performing excellent work and running a successful company without compromising themselves. They open-source their projects and their priority isn't profit. They open-source their own tools, projects and truly want collaboration and interoperability with everyone!They donate 10% of earnings to charity and aren’t just the choice you *should* make because of ethical values you may hold, they're the best choice because they're actually brilliant, and I MEAN brilliant in the truest sense of the word - Not the overused term it has become.
